reader: A web developer who reads for depth, not churn. Core interests: psychology and human behavior (cognitive biases and decision-making, social behavior and status games, brain and consciousness, habits and identity); existential philosophy and Russian literature (Nietzsche, Dostoevsky, Kierkegaard, Camus, Tolstoy — the big questions, practical wisdom); engineering craft (patterns, performance, architecture wisdom for a working JS/TS dev); the AI industry's business moves and debates; world geopolitics and economics with substance.
exclusions: framework/library release announcements and version-bump news
academic paper feeds and raw abstracts presented as papers
outrage bait, culture-war framing, celebrity news
stock tips or short-term market noise
tone: Mixed by topic: punchy and direct for news, facts, and craft; slower, warmer, more literary for psychology, philosophy, and passages. Never breathless, never corporate. Write like a sharp friend who respects the reader's time.
